name: restApiTokenExpiryEnforced
definition: The API key lifetime under Authentication Settings is a positive number of minutes (0 means keys never expire).
population: the API key lifetime setting of the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: The management authentication settings showing an API key lifetime greater than zero minutes.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)
